title: Parse the iHRIS use-case model reports
description: Verifies each uploaded CaseComplete .doc report (md5 and sha256), extracts it with antiword -w 0, and parses packages, use cases (all Details fields, main success scenario, extensions, notes), actors and requirements into library/ihris-use-cases/<product>.json (ihris-use-cases/v1) and <product>.md. Records references cited but never described, and writes crosswalk.json (ihris-use-case-crosswalk/v1): each use case to the iHRIS 4.3.3 forms its title names, by name matching only. Deterministic; stops on any text it does not recognise.
